title: feat: add Seedance 2.5
author: ElliotEtag
pr_body_excerpt:
## Summary

- Adds paid-only `seedance-2.5` as a new model; existing Seedance services remain unchanged.
- Routes Replicate `bytedance/seedance-2.5` with no alias, Pollinations GPU, or fallback.
- Supports four-second 480p and 720p video, first/last frames, and audio.
- Defaults omitted aspect ratio to 16:9 and documents the model-specific image and duration contract.
- Bills $0.1028/second at 480p and $0.2312/second at 720p with multiplier 1.

## Verification

- Local Gen text-only E2E: 480p 119.68s; 720p 124.50s (accepted exception).
- Two concurrent 480p calls passed in 118.25–118.36s.
- 720p with two frames and audio succeeded in 295.70s; output was 4.06s H.264 with stereo AAC.
- Exact billing passed at $0.4112/480p and $0.9248/720p. Identical retries were 27–41ms cache hits without rebilling.
- Auth, paid-only, errors, catalog, OpenAPI, registry pricing, snapshots, builds, tests, and typechecks passed.

## Merge gate

- Explicitly accept the 295.70s conditioned 720p path or narrow the public capability contract before merging.

gist.headline: Seedance gets cinematic
gist.blurb: A new paid Seedance model just landed in the garden, bringing four-second clips with frame control and sound. Polli has directed a tiny film. The budget was mostly pollen.
gist.summary: Added paid-only Replicate model `seedance-2.5` for four-second 480p or 720p video generation, with optional first/last frames and audio, a default 16:9 aspect ratio, and pricing of $0.1028/sec at 480p or $0.2312/sec at 720p.
gist.impact: Developers can now generate short Seedance 2.5 video clips through Pollinations with image-to-video framing and audio support, while identical retries return cached results without being billed again.
gist.visual_concept: Depict a cozy miniature film set for Seedance 2.5: Polli directs a retro CRT camera/monitor showing a four-second 16:9 video strip, with two small picture-frame props representing first and last frames and musical notes representing audio. Surround the set with code-plants, flowers, and a Seedance-labeled film reel; the monitor robot can eagerly hold the completed reel while Polli, wearing a director beret, watches the scene come alive.
